_comment: Topic stations, one per topic (docs/live-radio.md). Each entry is an already-servable radio contact with its OWN state and identity: `instance` keys both the state dir (agents/radio/instances/<instance>/) and the holder home (~/.idfon/<instance>), so schedules, briefs, submissions and content never mix. Start one with `scripts/radio-serve.sh <topic|instance|name>`; programme it with `scripts/radio-program.mjs ... --instance <instance>`. `topic` is also the live-call context topic, so the same agent directory serves every station. Shape mirrors agents/agency/roster.json on purpose: a switchboard is a roster of already-running contacts, not a spawner.
